detail.title: Globe 18 Wired Office Mouse with Type-C Adapter - Black
detail.overview: The Ant Globe 18 is a corded office mouse with an adjustable 800/1200/1600 DPI optical sensor and a fast 3300 fps tracking rate, giving smooth, low-delay cursor movement for office work, online classes and daily browsing. Its compact, ergonomic shape fits naturally in hand for fatigue-free all-day use, and a durable ABS build with switches rated for 1,000,000 clicks ensures long-term reliability. The 1.2m USB cable offers plug-and-play setup with no software required on Windows, Mac or Linux, and the package includes a bonus USB to Type-C OTG adapter for compatibility with newer laptops that lack a Type-A port.
